interaction.prompt: You have the puck in the neutral zone on a regroup. Scan the full width and tap your best outlet.

feedback.right: Hinge it horizontally to your D-partner swinging low into open ice. You keep possession, reset the angle, and attack the next opening with speed.
feedback.wrong: The center looks available in the mid-lane and the far winger is calling for the stretch, but both have defenders closing their lanes. Your D-partner swinging low is the one clean option — send it there and reset.

tip: A loud stick is not always an open stick. Scan the whole sheet before you commit the puck.
why: Scanning full width lets you identify your D-partner's safe hinge lane and keep possession instead of throwing a hopeful stretch pass into coverage.
